summary: The patient had a hospital stay lasting 15 days due to a fracture of bone, a closed fracture of hip, and an osteoporotic fracture of bone. During their stay, they were given Naproxen sodium 220 MG Oral Tablet as needed, but it was only given in the hospital and should not be continued at home. The patient was discharged to an unknown location.
risk_explanation: High risk. LACE 11 = L7 (15-day stay) + A3 (admitted through the ER) + C0 (Charlson 0) + E1 (1 ED visit in prior 6 months).
